text: A female figure with long black hair, pale skin, and a sharp angular face. She wears a form-fitting purple gown with high slit sides, black undergarments visible at the neckline, and holds a thin staff. Her pose is frontal, hands slightly raised. Other panels show her in profile and back views, all identical in costume and stance. Circular insets detail eyes, lips, ears, skin tone swatches, and fabric texture.
